package.name: crusader_mission
package.description:
Missions, one ROS action each, and the behaviour tree that sequences them. missions/ holds the action servers; tree/ holds the run structure as plain data plus renderers for it. Consumes crusader_fcu's republished topics and publishes guided setpoints; opens no device and no MAVLink connection.
tree/ deliberately depends on NO behaviour-tree library. The tree's shape is a team decision and has to be reviewable before anything is installed; which library ticks it is an implementation detail, and keeping it out of this package's dependencies is what keeps that choice reversible.
